description:
*Hollywood's Tainted Love* | Love is in the air! Well...love or lust? On this episode of LED Live, we are discussing where Valentines Day originated, why wedding rings are placed on the left hand, and the origins of the heart symbol. We will also be discussing how much influence the media has on our romantic lives.
